information_contract: Random/Dynamic A/R only. Dynamic common role planning uses shared delayed actor report; each own movement uses only that UAV's current self state. No actual UE positions/current fleet census/reward/future rollout enters controller.
explanation_contract: True-state diagnostic logging occurs after action execution only. Demand waterfall is fixed-snapshot accounting; bandwidth probes are sparse isolated what-if radio calculations, not causal energy ablations or benchmark parameter changes.
scope: Frozen checkpoints; no training or best reselection on test. Pilot is separate from ten held-out test traces. One training seed per learned arm; seed-wise paired scenario results do not measure training-seed variability.
